source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Give a facility-designated time-critical medication within its defined narrow timing window","B":"Give every scheduled medication at any convenient time during the entire nursing shift","C":"Use the same broad administration window for time-critical and non-time-critical medicines","D":"Delay a designated time-critical medication whenever unit workflow is temporarily busy"}}
source_row.rationale: A time-critical scheduled medication is one for which early or delayed administration beyond a defined narrow window could cause harm or reduce effectiveness. The nurse should follow the facility's approved time-critical window and medication-specific instructions rather than apply a broad shift-long window.
source_row.source_detail: Time-critical scheduled medications require a narrow institution-defined window; ISMP framework commonly uses within 30 minutes when early/late dosing beyond that may cause harm; accessed 2026-08-14.
source_row.source_name: ISMP — Guidelines for Timely Administration of Scheduled Medications
source_row.stem: A medication has been designated by the facility as a time-critical scheduled medication. How should the nurse approach its administration time?
